metadata.title: Lie-Lions brackets of nonlocal vector fields
metadata.abstract: We study nonlocal vector fields on the space of probability measures with finite second moment. Using Lions derivatives, we define their Lie-Lions bracket, which adds to the spatial Lie bracket a correction due to the evolution of the law, and prove that its vanishing is equivalent to commutation of the global flows, under first-order regularity and linear growth assumptions. We then construct a Lie algebra of complete polynomial nonlocal fields. For this class, we establish commutator and second-order Baker-Campbell-Hausdorff formulas with cubic remainders in the Wasserstein distance $W_2$, controlled by the second moment and uniform in the number of particles. The proofs rely on finite-particle realizations, which preserve the bracket and jointly determine the nonlocal field. We also obtain uniform estimates for smooth bounded kernels and a Leibniz rule for the action of polynomial fields on polynomial observables. Examples from collective dynamics show that the vanishing of the spatial bracket at a fixed law is neither necessary nor sufficient for commutation. They concern symmetries, aggregation-dependent rotation, synchronization, the transmission of a turn along a hierarchy, effective three-body interactions and occupancy-dependent circulation.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: 概率测度空间非局部向量场的Lie–Lions括号
analysis.workSummary: 在有限二阶矩概率测度空间上，以Lions导数定义Lie–Lions括号，在空间Lie括号之外加入分布演化修正；一阶正则和线性增长条件下，括号消失等价于全局流交换。对完全多项式非局部场建立Lie代数、交换子及二阶BCH公式，W₂中的三次余项由二阶矩控制且对粒子数一致。
analysis.breakthrough: 给无限粒子动力学可与有限系统相容的括号演算，并说明固定分布处的普通空间括号既非流交换必要也非充分条件。
analysis.limitations: 交换性与定量BCH对应不同正则类别，不能把三次余项推广到任意非局部场或丢掉全局流条件。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
